name: Cognitive Credit
description: Cognitive Credit connects Claude directly to institutional-grade credit market data. Search across company filings, prospectuses, and financial statements to surface the information you need. Fetch detailed financials for any covered company. Compare performance across peers and analyze key metrics over time. Purpose-built for credit analysts, Cognitive Credit brings structured, reliable data into your workflow without ever leaving the conversation.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Cognitive Credit to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Cognitive Credit to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.cognitivecredit.com/api/mcp/connect. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Cognitive Credit MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cognitive Credit provides these MCP tools: find_latest_prospectus, get_company_comparables, get_company_financials, get_company_listings, get_company_reporting_dates, get_company_time_series, get_document_metadata_values, get_tag_list, and search_company_documents.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Cognitive Credit?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Cognitive Credit in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.

_published_faq.name: Does Cognitive Credit MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cognitive Credit requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Cognitive Credit is developed by Cognitive Credit. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
